description: Unofficial Lain Iwakura fan-art companion from Serial Experiments Lain, in a fully clothed bear-pajamas desktop adaptation. Original choreography includes lifting the bear hood, powering a small computer, coiling a data cable, releasing a cable snag and using a compact NAVI. Brown hooded long-sleeved pajamas and closed slippers use simplified seams and stylized hair details, not an exact costume reproduction. Three articulated running directions and a crouch-jump complete the nine states.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
